desc:
Halloween event is here! Complete the candy hunts to obtain the three new accessories!
Old Halloween accessories have returned as well!

Credit of the Wolf school thumbnail goes to @posssummm

🐺 Explore this animal world and roleplay as an eagle, horse, wolf, bear, moose, rabbit, fox, raccoon, red panda, deer, cougar, leopard, or raven!

🎮 Features:
Detailed animal and color customization.
A variety of accessories to choose from.
Roleplay hosting and management.
5 different maps to choose from.

🎨 Customization & Controls
Change Animal: Click the fox head icon, then click the two animal heads icon at the top
Change Colors: Click the fox head icon, then choose Simple Colors (presets) or Advanced Colors (custom parts)
Fly: Double jump

Report bugs on the group wall (Humongous). Also look on the group description for info on ban appeals.

The basis of the animal models and animations are by MalberS Animations and Eosara!
Accessories (most) made by VenomousWolf84.
